# WL3 · Đăng nhập CSKH · sai mật khẩu

Group **WL · Đăng nhập, khung & mẫu tin (Next.js)** · state · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/login`) · account `anonymous`

## Purpose
State of [WL1](WL1.md) · Đăng nhập CSKH: sai mật khẩu. Page: Sign-in page of the CSKH dashboard: email and password.

## Agent and care context
- Email and password only, no clinic code; the session cookie is HttpOnly with a sliding and an absolute limit, the password hashed per person (ARCH-AI01 section 8).

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `anonymous` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: Public.
- Roles that can open the page: Anyone; after sign-in the person goes to `?next=` (same-origin path only), else the home of the role, else back to sign-in.
- Menu entry: not a menu entry (reached by link, redirect or the shell itself).

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- Field "Email" (autofocus), "Mật khẩu" with show or hide
- "Đăng nhập" (disabled while a field is empty or the request is busy)

## Business rules
- (notice on the page) "Sai email hoặc mật khẩu."
- Sign-in is by email and password only: no clinic code (one install = one clinic), the account is looked up by email; the session cookie is HttpOnly, with a sliding and an absolute limit (ARCH-AI01 section 8).
